turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I’ve been feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially toward the end of the day, to the point that it’s hard to take care of myself. I’ve also noticed some mild double vision, and I’ve had multiple illnesses recently while traveling and camping.
[ASK] Have you had severe muscle rigidity with high fever and confusion after starting or increasing an antipsychotic (neuroleptic) medication?

“No, I haven’t been on or changed any antipsychotic medication, and I don’t have severe muscle rigidity, high fever, or confusion. I mainly just feel progressively weak and fatigued later in the day, with mild double vision.”
[ASK] Have you had a persistent cough with shortness of breath that worsens with exertion and does not fully go away?
“No, I haven’t had a persistent cough or shortness of breath. My main issue is progressive fatigue and weakness toward the end of the day, with only mild double vision.”

“No, I’m not sure—I haven’t noticed worsening drooping or clear muscle-specific weakness that improves with rest. I mainly experience extreme fatigue and weakness later in the day, and only mild double vision, without other major symptoms.”

“No, I’m not aware of having chronic kidney failure, and I haven’t noticed any symptoms like decreased urination or swelling—I mainly have extreme fatigue and weakness later in the day with mild double vision.”

“No, I’m not experiencing changes in behavior or memory that I’d associate with frontotemporal dementia. I mainly just feel extremely fatigued and weak toward the end of the day, with mild double vision, and I haven’t had those kinds of cognitive or personality changes.”

“No, I haven’t been told I have CLL, and I don’t have any symptoms like swollen lymph nodes, unexplained bruising, or frequent infections—I mainly have extreme fatigue and weakness toward the end of the day with mild double vision.”
[DDX] Brief Psychotic Disorder, Chronic kidney failure, Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL), Factitious disorder, Frontotemporal Dementia
